subject: Workplace Skills
title: Decision Fatigue
description: A micro-lesson that makes Decision Fatigue usable.

hook.text: Judges grant parole 65% of the time after meals but nearly 0% before meals. Decision quality degrades with volume.

buildup.text: Every decision drains mental energy. By late afternoon, leaders default to the easiest option, not the best one.

discovery.text: Schedule important decisions in the morning when your brain is freshest. Batch small decisions to reduce volume.

twist.text: Routines eliminate decisions. Steve Jobs wore the same outfit every day to save decision energy for what mattered.

climax.text: Identify your five most recurring small decisions. Automate, routinize, or delegate them. Protect energy for big calls.

punchline.text: Protect decision energy. Automate the trivial calls.

quiz.question: How can leaders reduce the impact of decision fatigue?
options: Make all decisions quickly to avoid overthinking
Schedule major decisions early and automate or routinize small ones
Delegate all decisions to avoid fatigue entirely
